moto-gloves-turtle.name: ★ Moto Gloves | Turtle
moto-gloves-turtle.desc: These bulky hard knuckled gloves can protect the wearers hands from road rash at 60 mph. This green and grey pair has bright orange accents.

driver-gloves-dragon-fists.name: ★ Driver Gloves | Dragon Fists
driver-gloves-dragon-fists.desc: These driving gloves offer protection from the elements while still maintaining tactile sensation.

driver-gloves-overtake.name: ★ Driver Gloves | Overtake
driver-gloves-overtake.desc: These driving gloves offer protection from the elements while still maintaining tactile sensation. Speed is of the essence with these classic black and tan leather gloves.

specialist-gloves-marble-fade.name: ★ Specialist Gloves | Marble Fade
specialist-gloves-marble-fade.desc: Durable, breathable, and stylish; these gloves are designed to take (and give) a beating.

sport-gloves-big-game.name: ★ Sport Gloves | Big Game
sport-gloves-big-game.desc: Synthetic fabrics make these athletic gloves durable and eye-catching.

aug-bengal-tiger.name: AUG | Bengal Tiger
aug-bengal-tiger.desc: Powerful and accurate, the AUG scoped assault rifle compensates for its long reload times with low spread and a high rate of fire. It has been painted using a tiger stripe hydrographic.

awp-chrome-cannon.name: AWP | Chrome Cannon
awp-chrome-cannon.desc:
High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. Custom painted with mirror coat paint, this AWP is finished with multicolored accents and a carbon fiber scope.

"Where'd this come from? Why do you ask?" - Booth, Arms Dealer

awp-atheris.name: AWP | Atheris
awp-atheris.desc:
High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. A striking green and blue bush viper has been hand painted over a black base.

As deadly as it is beautiful

bayonet-case-hardened.name: ★ Bayonet | Case Hardened
bayonet-case-hardened.desc:
Relatively unchanged in its design since World War II, the bayonet still retains a place in modern military strategy. Bayonet charges have continued to be effective as recently as the second Gulf War and the war in Afghanistan. It has been color case-hardened through the application of wood charcoal at high temperatures.

A little color never hurt anyone

bayonet-autotronic.name: ★ Bayonet | Autotronic
bayonet-autotronic.desc: Relatively unchanged in its design since World War II, the bayonet still retains a place in modern military strategy. Bayonet charges have continued to be effective as recently as the second Gulf War and the war in Afghanistan. It has been anodized red and uses steel mesh to lighten the weight.

cz75-auto-army-sheen.name: CZ75-Auto | Army Sheen
cz75-auto-army-sheen.desc:
A fully automatic variant of the CZ75, the CZ75-Auto is the ideal short-term choice for turning the tables and gaining your opponents weapon. But with very little ammo in the magazine, strong trigger discipline is required. It has been covered in a metallic foil stamped with a camouflage pattern.

Remember your training

cz75-auto-circaetus.name: CZ75-Auto | Circaetus
cz75-auto-circaetus.desc:
A fully automatic variant of the CZ75, the CZ75-Auto is the ideal short-term choice for turning the tables and gaining your opponents weapon. But with very little ammo in the magazine, strong trigger discipline is required. A bird of prey carrying a snake has been custom painted on this CZ75.

A snake eater, minus the catchy theme song

desert-eagle-hypnotic.name: Desert Eagle | Hypnotic
desert-eagle-hypnotic.desc:
As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. It has been painted with a pearl base coat, then spray-painted black through a stencil in a graphic pattern.

You're not getting sleepy, you're passing out from blood loss

dual-berettas-polished-malachite.name: Dual Berettas | Polished Malachite
dual-berettas-polished-malachite.desc:
Firing two large-mag Berettas at once will lower accuracy and increase load times. On the bright side, you'll get to fire two large-mag Berettas at once. These Dual Berettas have been painted with striking green and silver colors. The grips are finished with a ceramic topcoat.

They command respect, although I can't say the same for you... - Booth, Arms Dealer

famas-waters-of-nephthys.name: FAMAS | Waters of Nephthys
famas-waters-of-nephthys.desc:
A cheap option for cash-strapped players, the FAMAS effectively fills the niche between more expensive rifles and the less-effective SMGs. The blues on this custom painted FAMAS shift as lighting conditions change.

Water always wins

five-seven-kami.name: Five-SeveN | Kami
five-seven-kami.desc:
Highly accurate and armor-piercing, the pricy Five-Seven is a slow-loader that compensates with a generous 20-round magazine and forgiving recoil. It has been painted using a hydrographic in a Japanese manga pattern.

Some ghosts won't stay buried

galil-ar-aqua-terrace.name: Galil AR | Aqua Terrace
galil-ar-aqua-terrace.desc:
A less expensive option among the terrorist-exclusive assault rifles, the Galil AR is a serviceable weapon in medium to long-range combat. It has been painted with a geometric motif in metallic paints.

Serenity now...

galil-ar-dusk-ruins.name: Galil AR | Dusk Ruins
galil-ar-dusk-ruins.desc:
A less expensive option among the terrorist-exclusive assault rifles, the Galil AR is a serviceable weapon in medium to long-range combat. Ancient gods are obscured in the background of this foliage-adorned pattern.

"Eyes up everyone—we're being watched..."

glock-18-clear-polymer.name: Glock-18 | Clear Polymer
glock-18-clear-polymer.desc:
The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. It has been painted with a tan slide and blue trigger. The frame is made of a clear polymer.

What you see is what you get

butterfly-knife-gamma-doppler-phase-4.name: ★ Butterfly Knife | Gamma Doppler
butterfly-knife-gamma-doppler-phase-4.desc: This is a custom-designed balisong, commonly known as a butterfly knife. The defining characteristic of this weapon is the fan-like opening of a freely pivoting blade, allowing rapid deployment or concealment. As a result, butterfly knives are outlawed in many countries. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

butterfly-knife-forest-ddpat.name: ★ Butterfly Knife | Forest DDPAT
butterfly-knife-forest-ddpat.desc:
This is a custom-designed balisong, commonly known as a butterfly knife. The defining characteristic of this weapon is the fan-like opening of a freely pivoting blade, allowing rapid deployment or concealment. As a result, butterfly knives are outlawed in many countries. It has been painted using a Digital Disruptive Pattern (DDPAT) hydrographic.

By the time you're close enough to notice the pixels it's already too late

paracord-knife-doppler-phase-1.name: ★ Paracord Knife | Doppler
paracord-knife-doppler-phase-1.desc:
This fixed-blade survival knife is designed to withstand being used as both a weapon and a tool, such as for setting traps, hunting animals or cutting foliage. The handle is wrapped in a length of multi-purpose paracord. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

paracord-knife-stained.name: ★ Paracord Knife | Stained
paracord-knife-stained.desc:
This fixed-blade survival knife is designed to withstand being used as both a weapon and a tool, such as for setting traps, hunting animals or cutting foliage. The handle is wrapped in a length of multi-purpose paracord. It has been given a forced patina using lemon and mustard dripped onto the surface.

If you think it's messy now, wait until you see it under a blacklight

classic-knife-stained.name: ★ Classic Knife | Stained
classic-knife-stained.desc:
A classic of the Counter-Strike series, the edge of this knife is press-fit Stellite perfectly held in place due to its precise fit with the titanium on the blade's cheek and spine. The handle is fossilized mastodon ivory held in a carbon fibre pocket. It has been given a forced patina using lemon and mustard dripped onto the surface.

If you think it's messy now, wait until you see it under a blacklight

flip-knife-slaughter.name: ★ Flip Knife | Slaughter
flip-knife-slaughter.desc:
Flip knives sport a Persian-style back-swept blade with an acute point.  While the point itself may be fragile, the overall design of the flip knife's design is surprisingly durable. It has been painted in a zebra-stripe pattern with aluminum and chrome paints with various reflectivities, and has then been covered with a tomato red candy coat.

Valeria doesn't pay Javier to ask questions... she pays him to pry out answers

gut-knife-lore.name: ★ Gut Knife | Lore
gut-knife-lore.desc: The most notable feature of a gut knife is the gut hook on the spine of the blade.  Originally popularized as an aid for field dressing game, the gut hook is also effective at  cutting through fibrous materials like rope, webbing, or safety belts with ease. It has been custom painted with knotwork.

m9-bayonet-gamma-doppler-phase-2.name: ★ M9 Bayonet | Gamma Doppler
m9-bayonet-gamma-doppler-phase-2.desc: This is the M-9 bayonet.  Originally intended to be mounted on a rifle, it is also well suited to close-quarters combat. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

shadow-daggers-case-hardened.name: ★ Shadow Daggers | Case Hardened
shadow-daggers-case-hardened.desc:
Designed for efficient brutality, using a push dagger is as simple as throwing a punch or two. It has been color case-hardened through the application of wood charcoal at high temperatures.

A little color never hurt anyone

shadow-daggers-autotronic.name: ★ Shadow Daggers | Autotronic
shadow-daggers-autotronic.desc: Designed for efficient brutality, using a push dagger is as simple as throwing a punch or two. It has been anodized red and uses steel mesh to lighten the weight.

bowie-knife-safari-mesh.name: ★ Bowie Knife | Safari Mesh
bowie-knife-safari-mesh.desc:
This full-tang sawback Bowie knife is designed for heavy use in brutal survival situations. It has been spray-painted using mesh fencing and cardboard cutouts as stencils.

A predator is a predator, no matter the environment

talon-knife-tiger-tooth.name: ★ Talon Knife | Tiger Tooth
talon-knife-tiger-tooth.desc:
This ivory-handled karambit features brass rivets and saw-tooth ridges, so it cuts on the way in, and tears on the way out. It has been anodized orange and hand-etched in a tiger stripe pattern.

Like the tiger it is rare... like the tiger it is deadly...

m249-blizzard-marbleized.name: M249 | Blizzard Marbleized
m249-blizzard-marbleized.desc: A strong open-area LMG, the M249 is the perfect choice for players willing to trade a slow fire rate for increased accuracy and a high ammo capacity. It has been painted in a marbleized pattern.

m249-bock-blocks.name: M249 | Bock Blocks
m249-bock-blocks.desc:
A strong open-area LMG, the M249 is the perfect choice for players willing to trade a slow fire rate for increased accuracy and a high ammo capacity. It has been custom painted with a purple graphic geometric design.

Stack 'em

m4a4-howl.name: M4A4 | Howl
m4a4-howl.desc: More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. It has been custom painted with the image of a snarling wolf.

mac-10-button-masher.name: MAC-10 | Button Masher
mac-10-button-masher.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. It has been custom painted to resemble a game pad and various buttons poking through a clear polymer casing.

Giving the phrase "console wars" a whole new meaning

mac-10-echoing-sands.name: MAC-10 | Echoing Sands
mac-10-echoing-sands.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. It has been custom painted using desert camouflage and environments as inspiration. A scarab has been painted under the wire form butt.

"WE'VE BEEN SET UP! THEY'RE EVERYWHERE!"

mp5-sd-desert-strike.name: MP5-SD | Desert Strike
mp5-sd-desert-strike.desc:
Often imitated but never equaled, the iconic MP5 is perhaps the most versatile and popular SMG in the world. This SD variant features an integrated silencer, making an already formidable weapon whisper-quiet. It has been custom painted with a high-tech design in tan and black.

Strike first, strike last

mp5-sd-lab-rats.name: MP5-SD | Lab Rats
mp5-sd-lab-rats.desc:
Often imitated but never equaled, the iconic MP5 is perhaps the most versatile and popular SMG in the world. This SD variant features an integrated silencer, making an already formidable weapon whisper-quiet. It features a hydrographic pattern depicting a mischief of rats.

—REDACTED—

mp5-sd-picnic.name: MP5-SD | Picnic
mp5-sd-picnic.desc:
Often imitated but never equaled, the iconic MP5 is perhaps the most versatile and popular SMG in the world. This SD variant features an integrated silencer, making an already formidable weapon whisper-quiet. A red pattern of offset X's has been applied.

It's a bit much, but isn't that the point? - Imogen, Arms Dealer In Training

mp7-bloodsport.name: MP7 | Bloodsport
mp7-bloodsport.desc:
Versatile but expensive, the German-made MP7 SMG is the perfect choice for high-impact close-range combat. It has been covered in white logo decals over a red and black hydrographic.

Space for rent

mp9-black-sand.name: MP9 | Black Sand
mp9-black-sand.desc:
Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. It has been custom painted with a tan and black military camo pattern.

"End their campaign before it begins"

negev-mjolnir.name: Negev | Mjölnir
negev-mjolnir.desc:
The Negev is a beast that can keep the enemy at bay with its pin-point supressive fire, provided you have the luxury of time to gain control over it. It has been custom painted red and features a number of Norse runes.

"This is all Loki's fault…"

negev-infrastructure.name: Negev | Infrastructure
negev-infrastructure.desc:
The Negev is a beast that can keep the enemy at bay with its pin-point supressive fire, provided you have the luxury of time to gain control over it. A hydrographic pattern of the 51st floor's construction, HVAC, and wiring plans has been applied.

All according to plan…

negev-nuclear-waste.name: Negev | Nuclear Waste
negev-nuclear-waste.desc: The Negev is a beast that can keep the enemy at bay with its pin-point supressive fire, provided you have the luxury of time to gain control over it. It has been painted with a hydrographic pattern of nuclear hazards symbols.

nova-wood-fired.name: Nova | Wood Fired
nova-wood-fired.desc:
The Nova's rock-bottom price tag makes it a great ambush weapon for a cash-strapped team. Its woodgrain base has been painted green and finished with blue accents and burned-in flames.

Gone hunting

nova-moon-in-libra.name: Nova | Moon in Libra
nova-moon-in-libra.desc:
The Nova's rock-bottom price tag makes it a great ambush weapon for a cash-strapped team. It has been painted with a hydrographic in a zodiac motif.

Today's a great day to find romance and kill your rivals

p250-crimson-kimono.name: P250 | Crimson Kimono
p250-crimson-kimono.desc:
A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. It has been painted with a hydrographic in a geometric motif.

Turner, all men can be broken... it's just a matter of finding the right pressure point - The Traitor and The Truthseeker Part 2

p250-wingshot.name: P250 | Wingshot
p250-wingshot.desc:
A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. It has been custom painted with a vibrant hydrographic.

Sometimes a subtle nudge is all it takes to get what you want - Franz Kriegeld, Phoenix Tactician

p90-desert-halftone.name: P90 | Desert Halftone
p90-desert-halftone.desc:
Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. A desert-colored halftone pattern has been applied.

All of the attitude with half the tone

r8-revolver-leafhopper.name: R8 Revolver | Leafhopper
r8-revolver-leafhopper.desc:
The R8 Revolver delivers a highly accurate and powerful round at the expense of a lengthy trigger-pull. Firing rapidly by fanning the hammer may be the best option when point-blank stopping power is required. Its green base coat has been lightly color case-hardened through the application of wood charcoal at high temperatures.

An evergreen offering

r8-revolver-night.name: R8 Revolver | Night
r8-revolver-night.desc:
The R8 Revolver delivers a highly accurate and powerful round at the expense of a lengthy trigger-pull. Firing rapidly by fanning the hammer may be the best option when point-blank stopping power is required. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a night ops color scheme.

It's the whisper of the wind... it's the bite at your neck

sawed-off-amber-fade.name: Sawed-Off | Amber Fade
sawed-off-amber-fade.desc:
The classic Sawed-Off deals very heavy close-range damage, but with its low accuracy, high spread and slow rate of fire, you'd better kill what you hit. It has been painted by airbrushing transparent paints that fade together over a chrome base coat.

This isn't just a weapon, it's a conversation piece - Imogen, Arms Dealer In Training

scar-20-splash-jam.name: SCAR-20 | Splash Jam
scar-20-splash-jam.desc: The SCAR-20 is a semi-automatic sniper rifle that trades a high rate of fire and powerful long-distance damage for sluggish movement speed and big price tag. It has been painted using a photographic hunting camo hydrographic.

scar-20-crimson-web.name: SCAR-20 | Crimson Web
scar-20-crimson-web.desc:
The SCAR-20 is a semi-automatic sniper rifle that trades a high rate of fire and powerful long-distance damage for sluggish movement speed and big price tag. It has been painted using a spider web-patterned hydrographic over a red base coat and finished with a semi-gloss topcoat.

Be careful where you walk, you never know where the web is spread

sg-553-hypnotic.name: SG 553 | Hypnotic
sg-553-hypnotic.desc:
The terrorist-exclusive SG553 is a premium scoped alternative to the AK47 for effective long-range engagement. It has been painted with a pearl base coat, then spray-painted black through a stencil in a graphic pattern.

You're not getting sleepy, you're passing out from blood loss

sg-553-bleached.name: SG 553 | Bleached
sg-553-bleached.desc:
The terrorist-exclusive SG553 is a premium scoped alternative to the AK47 for effective long-range engagement. It has been spray-painted with a pattern of animal skulls.

All that remains

ssg-08-rapid-transit.name: SSG 08 | Rapid Transit
ssg-08-rapid-transit.desc:
The SSG08 bolt-action is a low-damage but very cost-effective sniper rifle, making it a smart choice for early-round long-range marksmanship. It has been custom painted with fictitious transit diagrams designed around the maps of Counter-Strike.

"Where are we headed?"

zeus-x27-earth-mandala.name: Zeus x27 | Earth Mandala
zeus-x27-earth-mandala.desc:
Perfect for close-range ambushes and enclosed area encounters, the rechargeable x27 Zeus is capable of incapacitating an enemy in a single hit. A multicolored mandala pattern has been applied.

It's about the journey

tec-9-ice-cap.name: Tec-9 | Ice Cap
tec-9-ice-cap.desc:
An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. It has been painted with a blue and white abstract hydrographic.

Submerge the opposition

tec-9-brother.name: Tec-9 | Brother
tec-9-brother.desc:
An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. It has been custom painted with a brown and gold camo pattern and a T-sided agent beneath the rear sight.

I'll watch our butts

usp-s-para-green.name: USP-S | Para Green
usp-s-para-green.desc:
A fan favorite from Counter-Strike Source, the Silenced USP Pistol has a detachable silencer that gives shots less recoil while suppressing attention-getting noise. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a khaki green and black color scheme.

Who he was doesn't change who he has become.  Don't worry Felix... I'll stop him - The Paladin and The Teacher Part 2

xm1014-ancient-lore.name: XM1014 | Ancient Lore
xm1014-ancient-lore.desc:
The XM1014 is a powerful fully automatic shotgun that justifies its heftier price tag with the ability to paint a room with lead fast. A pale green, beige, and red pattern of ancient tiles has been applied.

"Hope remains, even for those who began their journey down the wrong path"

xm1014-monster-melt.name: XM1014 | Monster Melt
xm1014-monster-melt.desc:
The XM1014 is a powerful fully automatic shotgun that justifies its heftier price tag with the ability to paint a room with lead fast. A collection of monsters has been custom painted on both sides of this XM1014.

"Best to not check the other side"

xm1014-watchdog.name: XM1014 | Watchdog
xm1014-watchdog.desc:
The XM1014 is a powerful fully automatic shotgun that justifies its heftier price tag with the ability to paint a room with lead fast. It has been custom painted with a jade green base and two guardian lions watching either direction. A third lion has been painted beneath the rear sight.

Protect and prosper
